description: A joint academic-industrial consortium in the EU unexpectedly demonstrates a new class of energy-efficient neuromorphic chips capable of running models at 55.0 capability on-device, bypassing cloud dependency. The breakthrough emerges from repurposed sensor research and leverages EU-controlled materials, sparking interest in sovereign edge AI. While not matching frontier performance, it enables resilient, offline-capable systems for critical infrastructure, and shifts investment attention toward distributed compute architectures.
